parameters.name: AliyunLang
parameters.description: The language. Valid values: zh and en. Default value: zh.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace where the ServiceMonitor is located.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms update-env-service-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --aliyun-lang zh --environment-id env-xxxxx --namespace arms-prom --service-monitor-name serviceMonitor1 --dry-run true --config-yaml '参见补充说明。' --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms UpdateEnvServiceMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --EnvironmentId 'env-xxxxx' --DryRun true --AliyunLang zh --ConfigYaml '参见补充说明。' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace 'arms-prom' --ServiceMonitorName serviceMonitor1
